name: Field Formatter Theme
description: provides custom theme-suggestion settings for field formatters.
project_description:
Allows site builders to add field theme suggestions in the field formatter settings.

 Post-Installation 
 Settings are found in the field formatter settings in the entity display form. Go to the "Manage display" tab for content types, users, and other entities. A text box is available for each field, revealed by using the formatter settings edit button (gear wheel icon) for that field. Enter a space-separated list of terms that will be added as field theme suggestions.
